title: TaskRunCommandRequest
description: JSON-RPC request to send a command to the agent server in the sandbox.

method.description:
Command method to execute on the agent server

* `user_message` - user_message
* `cancel` - cancel
* `close` - close
* `permission_response` - permission_response
* `set_config_option` - set_config_option

id.description: Optional JSON-RPC request ID (string or number)
